(Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India | June 2007 – December 2010) — Led UI engineering pods for enterprise web clients, translating concept visualizations into robust implementations; conducted usability studies, competitive benchmarking, and heuristic evaluations; partnered with organizational leads on architecture decisions, UI design standards, and industry best practices.

(Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India | August 2004 – June 2007) — Formulated frontend and SEO strategy across UI/UX design, development standards, and W3C web compliance; directed concept visualization, application user flows, and client-side R&D on emerging web technologies.

## Featured Personal & Open-Source Projects
- **FoodScan AI**: Mobile AI application live on the Google Play Store (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gen.lets.foodscan) for conscious travelers (Vegetarian, Jain, Vegan, Celiac gluten-free, and allergen-sensitive). Features dual barcode and multilingual OCR scanning under one second to decode foreign packaging ingredients and E-numbers with deterministic dietary safeguards. Includes companion web packaging marks guide (https://foodscan.lets.gen.in/packaging-marks).
- **EdgeNonce**: Zero-latency CSP nonce streaming engine running on Cloudflare Workers and HTMLRewriter. Injects unique 128-bit dynamic nonces on the fly (<1.5ms) without breaking origin CDN or AEM Dispatcher caching (100% cache retention). Enforces strict CSP Level 3 to satisfy PCI-DSS v4.0 (6.4.3 & 11.6.1), HIPAA, and GDPR (https://www.edge-nonce.com). Documentation: AEM Architecture Guide (https://www.edge-nonce.com/aem-services.html) and IHS Apache Configs (https://www.edge-nonce.com/apache-ihs-integration-guide.html).
- **StateGuard.js**: JavaScript utility locking DOM attributes against DevTools tampering for BFSI state integrity (https://rmsuthar.github.io/StateGuard/).
- **Global Edge Sandbox & LB Inspector**: Cloudflare Workers edge computing platform simulating 12 PoP locations globally with WebAuthn auth (https://gateway.lets.gen.in/).
- **Developer Tools & Applications Hub**: Platform hosting specialized utility tools including Gujarat Panchang & Broadcast System (https://tithi.lets.gen.in/) and Digital Table Clock & Calendar PWA (https://clock.lets.gen.in/) at https://ravindra.lets.gen.in/tools.
